name: Jovan III
description: Jovan III, often called simply Jovan, was a planet located in the Jovan system and was noted for the Jovan Station, built in orbit around the planet.
lead_paragraphs: Jovan III, often called simply Jovan, was a planet located in the Jovan system and was noted for the Jovan Station, built in orbit around the planet.
Jovan III was a fertile planet and one of the premier agriworld of the Gordian Reach. It was crisscrossed by robo-harvesters and dotted with agricultural research labs.
